name: On the Cusp of Nether
source:
What Awaits You... 

A nightmare or the afterlife? 

The golden eye of a god peers into your soul. Don't become infatuated with his ethereal beauty—he can see the rot hidden inside you.

[From [url=https://akua-kourin.itch.io/on-the-cusp-of-nether]itch.io[/url]]
